impact: Fading follow-through in Korean memory after Nvidia's beat is a soft signal for DRAM, MU and SNXX heading into the US session.
summary: The Kospi fell about 1.4% to 4,996.43 by mid-morning Thursday, giving back part of Wednesday's Nvidia-driven rebound (close 5,067.44), as pension funds sold chip stocks. Samsung Electronics traded at 190,900 won (-1.95%) and SK Hynix at 1,132,000 won (-1.05%). The market opened an hour late for Korea's college entrance exam.
title: Kospi slips 1.4% below 5,000 as pension funds sell Samsung, SK Hynix
